title: Lock In session
description: One work session, stored as ~/.lockin/sessions/<id>.json. These files are the record of your work: History, the day review and `lockin history` are built from them. Lock In rewrites a session's file when the session changes, and the open session's file on every checkpoint. A file that doesn't match this schema is skipped and never overwritten.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, for editors that validate JSON.

id.description: The session's identity. The file is named after it.

ended_at.description: Absent while the session is open. At most one session is open.

checkpoint_at.description: While the session is open, the last time Lock In confirmed it was running. If Lock In quits unexpectedly, the time after this becomes a pause.

target_seconds.description: The work target. Work beyond it is recorded as overtime.

finished_naturally.description: True when the session was finished after reaching its target; false when it was ended early.

end_reason.description: Why the session was ended before its target.

reviewed.description: Whether the end-of-session review was saved.

intervals.description: The session's timeline in order. Each interval ends where the next starts; only the last can be open.

events.description: Notes recorded during the session with `lockin event add`, in the order they were added.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601. Lock In writes UTC with microseconds, e.g. 2026-11-03T09:00:00.000000Z.

title.description: May be empty only for the planner's blank row.

link.description: An http(s) link for the task, such as a Linear issue, GitHub pull request or Notion page.

roll_into_next_session.description: Chosen in the review: copy this task into the next session's plan.

source_task_id.description: The task this one was carried forward from.

event.description: Something that happened during the session, in your words.

kind.description: work: toward the target. overtime: work after the target was reached. break: earned break time. pause: time away, with a reason.

ended_at.description: Absent on the interval still running.

backfilled.description: True for work added afterwards with `lockin backfill`.
